newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures gain on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures gain on speculative buying.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery gained five rupees to 1,149.50 rupees per quintal on Tuesday on speculative buying and low arrivals, traders said.
They said farmers celebrating a Hindu festival had not moved their stocks to markets in castorseed producing centres.
In edible oils, groundnut lost 3.0 rupees to 368 rupees per 10 kgs. In Rajkot, it rose 4.0 rupees to 568 rupees per 15 kg.
Imported palm oil lost two rupees to 295 rupees per 10 kg.
